item.title: Shaq Breaks Down Jokic–Dort Tussle
item.description: Shaq Shaquille O’Neal weighs in on the Nikola Jokic–Lu Dort scuffle during Thunder vs. Nuggets, defending Jokic’s reaction.

item.title: Shaq's Big Man Alliance and Another Classic Studio Moment
item.description: Shaq reignites his “Big Man Alliance” philosophy during a Timberwolves vs. Nuggets broadcast, mixing humor, high standards, and classic studio banter.

item.title: When Shaq Met His Height Match: The Viral Moment Fans Can’t Stop Watching
item.description: A viral video shows Shaq standing next to the world’s tallest professional female model Ekaterina Lisina...wow!

item.title: Shaq Surprises Georgia Teen With VIP NBA Dream Trip
item.description: Shaq surprises Georgia teen Brandon Simmons with a VIP Minnesota Timberwolves trip after his inspiring recovery from a life-changing accident.

item.title: Shaq's Hilarious Reaction to Celtics' Scheierman’s Breakout Night
item.description: Shaq had a hilarious reaction after seeing Celtics rookie Baylor Scheierman’s breakout performance against the Cavaliers on Inside the NBA.

item.title: Shaq On Adebayo’s 83-Point Explosion: “Jealous… But Happy for Him!”
item.description: Shaq to Bam Adebayo’s incredible 83-point game for the Miami Heat, praising the historic performance while joking he wishes it had been him.

item.title: Round 2: Shaq, Barkley on Adebayo's 83
item.description: Shaq celebrates Bam Adebayo’s historic 83-point game and shares his classic advice: if you’ve got a shot at history, go for it.

item.title: Shaq Steps Up Big Again, Covering Funeral Costs for Georgia Girl
item.description: Shaq shows his big heart once again, stepping in to help a grieving Georgia family by covering funeral expenses for 12-year-old Jada West.

item.title: Shaq, Sir Charles Keep It Real: Still Not Buying the 3-Point Revolution
item.description: Shaq and Charles Barkley continue to speak their minds on today’s NBA style of play—and fans can’t get enough of their old-school honesty.

item.title: Shaq Salutes Ovechkin’s 900th Goal in Classic Big Diesel Style
item.description: Shaq celebrates Alex Ovechkin’s 900th goal with a signed sneaker and a classic Big Diesel message in this cross-sport moment of greatness.
